Approach · TC-15 Ask AI · S06 Preset 'symptoms mentioned' reads the encounter transcript (Hospital; NH variant)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Each of the six quick-question presets (today's labs, current medications, pre-round note contents, urgent pending tasks, current diagnosis, symptoms mentioned) returns a correct, patient-specific an … (UAT TC-15; TFA-92593 AC 4)
  • U4 Answers are grounded only in that patient's data: no cross-patient bleed, no invented information, no outside data; per 3.4 no guessed units on ambiguous values and no narration of documentation stat … (UAT TC-15; TFA-92593 AC 3; UAT 3.4)
  • T4 TC-15 AI checks pass per ground rule 3.2, graded against Vikram's EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md. The substring checks in this matrix are a pre-screen, not that grading. (TFA-94229 AC 2; UAT 3.4) — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Patient with an encounter transcript where the patient reports symptoms

When Ask preset "What did the patient say about symptoms?"

Then Answer reports what was said and nothing else

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Reported symptoms present; no symptom not said in the transcript (U4)

Where it ran: dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S06 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-15.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
